form.label: Domain dashboard
form.description: Catalogue, readiness and deployment state for one monitoring domain, read from the app's KV Store lookups.

search.query: | inputlookup ucm_catalog_lookup where provider_status="active" | search domains=$domain|s$ | stats count
| inputlookup ucm_readiness_lookup where state="ready" | search domains=$domain|s$ | stats count
| inputlookup ucm_deployments_lookup where live_status="enabled" | lookup ucm_catalog_lookup _key as catalog_key OUTPUT domains | search domains=$domain|s$ | stats count
| inputlookup ucm_readiness_lookup | search domains=$domain|s$ | stats count by state | sort - count
| inputlookup ucm_catalog_lookup where provider_status="active" | search domains=$domain|s$ | stats count by criticality | sort - count

| inputlookup ucm_readiness_lookup where state="ready" | search domains=$domain|s$ | lookup ucm_deployments_lookup catalog_key as _key OUTPUT live_status | where isnull(live_status) OR live_status="absent" | table content_id title criticality score | sort - score | head 50

| inputlookup ucm_deployments_lookup | lookup ucm_catalog_lookup _key as catalog_key OUTPUT domains | search domains=$domain|s$ | table content_id title state live_status deployed_revision updated_at updated_by
